query: SELECT st.entity_id,st.source_id,st.last_attempt::text AS last_attempt,st.last_success::text AS last_success,st.last_error,(st.last_success IS NULL OR st.last_success < now() - s.schedule_seconds * interval '2 seconds') AS stale FROM source_entity_state st JOIN sources s ON s.id=st.source_id JOIN entities e ON e.id=st.entity_id WHERE NOT e.retired ORDER BY st.source_id,st.entity_id
